title: Marx1337 Identity Reveal: Unmasking the Operator Behind SMS Gateway Data Sales
content_md: Marx is a high-volume database and access broker whose core product is resold SMS gateway logs, not breaches of the brands named in them. He posts as Marx on DarkForums and as Marx1337 on XSS, with 76 DarkForums threads dated 20 September to 17 November 2026. The operation traces back to an earlier identity, Machine1337, registered on XSS in January 2024. The catalog shows a clear tiering: SMS gateway log slices relabeled with global brand names (banking, travel, retail, technology and crypto), sold per dataset and priced by record count. Regional SMS log slices with readable message content, including transaction alerts and one-time passcodes, concentrated in the Gulf and India. Non-SMS database sales, added since late October: business leads, customer records, gaming credentials, identity documents and healthcare directories, sold as flat files. Panel access sales and free teasers: admin panels in finance and logistics, plus free samples that promote larger collections. The mix of sectors and countries indicates that Marx’s objective is monetizing data and access, not targeting any organization, sector or region.
